title: A'erly
description: A’erly is a newly founded arcane town built after the Awakening on the northeast shore of Soulmire that serves as the capital of the Tegenwald territory. The town was shaped through, with a circular design and lake-facing terraces. To outsiders, A’erly feels quiet, precise, and purposeful—a place built to endure, not to impress.

title: Abbey of Light
description: The Abbey of Mont Rest, recently renamed the Abbey of Light, sits atop the tall foothills where the Distancion Mountains descend into the Borealian Sway. The abbey has expanded its studies to include all gods of Myrdae and is well-known for an unusual alliance with a group of Stone Giants, who have protected the abbey for 150 years.

title: Adsuren
description: Resting between Mount Eathea and the Wehgyn River, Adsuren is a humble village that has seen great prosperity over the past many years, its people are kind and there is always a great sense of community with a thriving market that is in constant use.

title: Ahndashere
description: Ahndashere is a resilient river–sea town built half on stilts over swampy waters and half upon a rare rise of dry hills at its center. Lantern-lit boardwalks, weathered docks, and the hum of both riverfolk and hillstead life give the settlement a rugged charm.

title: Alburest
description: Alburest sits on the eastern edge of Lochlorn, where the Deep Route road meets the water’s edge and disappears beneath the lake. Once an inland trade hub, it’s now a lakeside city of smokehouses, boats, and drowned roads—known for its rich smoked eel and the shimmering mystery of the loch that reshaped it.

title: Argent Halls
description: The Argent Halls is an academy of historical study and is the headquarters for the Advents of Harmony. It contains replicated copies of all archived history (originals are kept in the Uktali Monastery) and widely visited for research.

title: Basctdelm
description: The largest city in Myrdae, a thriving and fortified metropolis on the Dabaryn River, serving as the capital of Halesworth and ruled by Queen Breya Talward.

title: Climbor
description: A city in the Rostiena Foothills at the base of the Vanapur Mountains, governed by a council of four influential families and known for its strict social order, including the enforced confinement of the gabuks to a subterranean district beneath the city.

title: Deadfield
description: Deadfield is a brutal, sun-scorched city of black rune-carved stone walls in the heart of the Mahruud, centered on its vast square fighting pit known as The Field. Ruled by the red dragonborn Mahl, it offers desert-hardened markets, and hidden sub-level tunnels as refuge from heat and sandstorms.

title: Dha Chaomhnoir
description: A wealthy and bustling coastal city on the southern shores of Inverland, home to the largest Vaults of the Reserve, with a thriving port, and an exaggerated class system that distinguishes the wealthy.

title: Dunduar
description: Dunduar is an ancient dwarven city carved deep into the stone beneath the Baltwood, long regarded as one of the great strongholds of dwarven endurance and craft. Built along the roots of the Distancion Mountains, the city is famed for its disciplined clans, master smiths, and vast stone halls.

title: Emberstran
description: The city of Emberstran stands on the Glimmering Sea, south of the Severed Crease mountain range. During the Awakening, there was fear that the city would be destroyed, as it was trapped between the expanding Glimmering Sea and by the eruption of Mount Emberstran, but the city survived and prospered.

title: Everlight
description: Nestled in a hidden valley, this village emerged from a cataclysm that reshaped the land centuries ago during the formation of the Blustery Waste in Arbescar. Opposing the barren expanse of the surrounding land, Everlight was shielded by Urlich, the Regent of Ice, who brought a perpetual winter to insulate the village.

title: Fal'Thalor
description: An elven settlement in the Borealian Sway in the lower foothills of the Distancion Mountains nestled deep in the forest. The town often welcomes travellers entering the Bathaen Empire from the dwarven city Thel Kohldur.

title: Felden
description: The town of Felden sits high on a large hill in the eastern Rostiena Foothills. The most commercial and prosperous residence occupy the most elevated parts surrounded by numerous farmlands. There are several cave entrances that lead to protective areas and mines within the hill the town rests upon.

title: Ferndale
description: One of the most well known towns in Halesworth, Ferndale sits in a valley on the Seaglow river and is known for it's luminescent wildlife. The town has always strived for peace and tranquility, but has been constantly plagued attacks from orc and unseelie fey emerging from the surrounding woodlands.

title: Gevakaln
description: A prosperous city sitting on the coast of the Sea of Sondera in the western Rostiena Foothills. Gevakaln is know for it's three districts that are divided by the class structure of its citizens.

title: Gibuldon
description: One of the largest cities and centrally located in Inverland, Gibuldon is a the capital of Inverland. It is a lively and diverse settlement on Loch Cerule.

title: Habadin
description: Known for it's predominate ulbin population, Habadin is one of the most well known cities in the Underdark. The city was at the center of many battles of the Blood Wars that came to Myrdae.

title: Harbok
description: A small town overlooking the Glimmering Sea in Orbansia.

title: Hesfal
description: Is a village known for it's artisans and crafts, located halfway between Deadfield and Tratta on the Tor March on the western edge of the Yearning Vale.

title: Kelaad
description: Also known as Featherwell, Kelaad is a coastal village nestled on the southern end of Holder’s Cove, that thrives on fishing, trade, boatwright and the wisdom of its healers and mystics.

title: Lehnthru'akk
description: A town set deep in the Yearning Slough, Lehnthru'akk is known for it's very unusual citizenry that is made up mostly of monsters that are feared elsewhere in Myrdae. While difficult to get to, the town welcomes the occasional outsider and is protected by the renown wyrm, Zovraesdria.

title: Leoning
description: A major city that sees far into the Delisnor Ocean, Leoning is a massive hub for all sorts of people to meet and trade. Leoning also functions as the “capital” of sorts for those who deem themselves proud people of Camburne.

title: Mistforge
description: This village is in a valley in northern Orbansia that is across the Distancion Mountains from where the Crungess was once.

title: Nauldeaus
description: Starting out simply as the port town “Wave’s Edge” before becoming the large city it is today, Nauldeaus is the gateway to Lake Tribathe, the large body of water that is known as the hub of the Bathaen Empire.

title: Nunglthil
description: Nunglthil is a rare neutral trading outpost in the Underdark, where surface folk and subterranean peoples can barter safely. It is a crooked crescent of docks, shanties, and cavern-carved halls clinging to the edge of a vast black lake.

title: Nurador
description: The village of Nurador sits at the northwestern tip of the Kaltera Mountains in Orbansia. The village has been a hotbed of conflict between the local elven and orc population.

title: O'naren
description: A tranquil elven settlement nestled in the wooded foothills west of Qal'dynn, where finely carved stone structures blend harmoniously with the natural gray, green, and brown landscape.

title: Ol'Morrey
description: One of the oldest town on the southern coast of Inverland, Ol'Morrey is a proud port town whose primary exports are fish, shellfish, and pearls.

title: Oldport
description: A historic harbor town on the stormy eastern coast of Inverland, renowned for its rich maritime trade, perilous waters, and deep-rooted seafaring traditions along the Tideless Span.

title: Palason
description: Capital of the Frystarian Strand, Palason is a large city in the north of the Bathaen Empire. Being north, the winters can be harsh, but the lands are fertile with woods and farmlands being plentiful around the city.

title: Qal'dynn
description: The largest city in the Borealian Sway, a serene and orderly elven establishment built among dense wooded foothills, where cascading rivers and lakes blend seamlessly with tall, ornate spires and natural forested beauty.

title: Riverside
description: Riverside is a historic town hub at the crossroads of the Borealian Sway, Wheldrake, and Frystarian Strand territories, where fertile lands, well-traveled roads, and the Blustari River converge make it a great place for trade.

title: Scarwatch Hold
description: This old keep that was damaged during the awakening is now renovated. It sits atop the Jagged Waste Crags on the western border of the Yearning Vale, overlooking the Mahruud.

title: Shademoor
description: A mist-laden town in Halesworth, known for its tragic past, the sprawling Garden cemetery, and its famed Mottleberry harvest, where fog drifts through its streets each twilight, cloaking its mysteries in shadow.

title: Skrettel
description: Sitting on plateaus and carved into the mountainside, Skrettel is a magnificent city built for the likings of weefolk

title: Staghaven
description: Nestled in one of the densest forested areas of Kilgreen is the small hamlet of Staghaven. Its modest buildings, developed by newcomers from Ulkef, are spread out along a tributary that feeds into the Tossing Run River.

title: Stoneshore
description: Sitting on the coast of the Sea of Sondera on the western portions of the Rostiena Foothills, Stoneshore is the premier city of trade in Orbansia.

title: Strolsworth
description: This working class town sits across Loch Cerule from Gibuldon where the Tariat River ends, and has been subject to harboring organized crime over the past few decades.

title: Tarnsport
description: Known as the home to Thalex Stormvigor, this small town is on the northeastern edge of the Borealian Sway on the Blustari River.

title: Tirncall
description: Sometimes overshadowed by Caldwynn, Tirncall is a small town that is home to many mercenaries and those who wish to hide from the reaches of the law.

title: Trailpoint
description: This crossroad town lies in the center of the Severed Bend territory on the eastern side of Orbansia and is known for horse racing and huge varieties of gourds.

title: Tratta
description: A grand city on the coast of the Broken Deep, known for its bustling sea trade, impressive sandstone architecture with domes and arches, a renowned arena, a grand theater, and an ancient mage tower.

title: Tyne’vale
description: This small town sits on the borders of the Gaelscape and Caristone territories along the Tossing Run river.

title: Tyrynder
description: A small town in the southern Rostiena Foothills set deep in the woods off the coast of the Sea of Marilia.

title: Uktali Monastery
description: Uktali Monastery is known for its monks dedicated to exploration, history and knowledge. Uktali monks protect and preserve original text, tomes, scroll and Avantee journals with a second archival in the Argent Halls.

title: Ulgrey
description: Ulgrey is an old village sitting at the fork in on Greyrun river.

title: Ulkef
description: Located in the Gaelscape territory, Ulkef is a small city that has prospered since the Awakening. Ulkef gained its reputation as home to resilient people due to their strength and fortitude in holding off the dead of the Witherwoods prior to the Awakening.

title: Valenlun
description: A small farm hamlet that has not grown more than 50 members in the past century, Valenlun is comprised of a few buildings on a main road and farms and woods surrounding it for many miles.

title: Waypoint
description: This village sits in the heart of the Aelbon territory in southern Inverland and is a common stopping point for those travelling between Blackfield and Dha Chaomhnoir.

title: Wheldrake
description: This well known village in the Bathaen Empire sits between Basctdelm and Palason and is responsible for the newly defined territory of Wheldrake after the Awakening.

title: Witguard
description: This small settlement is located on the southern edge of the Rostiena Foothills.

title: Ys'Nonterien
description: Drow settlement on Rothenloch in the Underdark
